title: Life Cycles of Plants and Animals
seo_title: Grade 3 Life Cycle Worksheets: Butterflies, Frogs, Plants and More
standard_text: Develop models to describe that organisms have unique and diverse life cycles but all have in common birth, growth, reproduction, and death.
meta_desc: Free Grade 3 science worksheets on life cycles (NGSS 3-LS1-1): butterfly, frog, grasshopper, chicken and plant life cycles, metamorphosis, life cycle diagrams and comparing life cycles. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_big: All living things are born, grow, reproduce and die.
key_sub: Life cycles have different stages, like egg, caterpillar, chrysalis and butterfly, but every cycle starts again with reproduction.
body_html:
How to think about it

A life cycle is the stages a living thing goes through. Every life cycle includes birth, growth, reproduction (making young) and death.

Life cycles are different: a butterfly and a frog change shape a lot (metamorphosis), a grasshopper goes from egg to nymph to adult, a puppy looks like a small dog, and a plant goes from seed to seedling to adult plant to flower and fruit.

Example

What comes after a tadpole?

The tadpole grows legs.

It becomes a froglet.

Answer: froglet

Example

What do a bean plant and a chicken have in common?

Both are living things.

Answer: Both are born, grow, reproduce and die.

Common mistakes

  • Thinking a caterpillar or tadpole is a different animal.
  • Thinking all animals have the same stages.
  • Forgetting that plants have life cycles too.
